_doc: Example tyre mileage ledger. Copy to tyres.json and edit. Tyres are tied to WHEELSETS, not bikes. Mileage = sum of qualifying outdoor rides since fitted_date across the wheelset's Strava gear_ids. Indoor rides are excluded: VirtualRide, trainer=true, or a plain Ride with no GPS start location. Manage it with scripts/tyres.py (add-wheelset, add-set --replace, retire) rather than by hand; the report is scripts/tyre-mileage.sh.
